cutoff_window.rule: Only visibly published or updated public sources strictly after the start and no later than run time qualify.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Copilot model policy API for enterprise, orgs, and teams
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced generally available REST GET and PATCH endpoints for Copilot model policies at enterprise, enterprise-team, agent-app, and organization scopes.

local_practice_implications.why_it_matters: A governed agent-start boundary can require the effective model-route policy and delegation scope to be identified before mutable work starts.
Readiness checks should verify the model-policy scope that applies to the agent environment, rather than assuming a locally selected model is authorized.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Multi-repository support and other improvements for GitHub Copilot in Slack and Microsoft Teams
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced that @GitHub can work across multiple repositories in one Slack or Teams conversation and can use shared messages and threads as context.

local_practice_implications.why_it_matters: A conversation-to-repository handoff needs the authorized repositories, shared-context provenance, and human review point recorded.
Task packages should declare the repositories and conversation context in scope, avoiding an implicit expansion from a chat thread into multiple codebases.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Agentic autofix for code scanning alerts general availability
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub announced general availability of agentic autofix for code-scanning alerts: it explores files, proposes a fix, reruns CodeQL, iterates if needed, then opens a draft pull request with a validation summary for review.

local_practice_implications.why_it_matters: Command-capable repair workflows should retain scope, validator output, iteration evidence, and a human review boundary.
A review package should connect explored files to the proposed repair, the validator rerun, and the resulting evidence summary.
Rerunning authoritative scanners and reviewing draft pull requests consume verification capacity and should be planned as gates, not assumed agent completion.
An agent-generated fix remains a candidate until independent scanner evidence and review have been evaluated.

qualifying_updates.source_title: Why AI coding is widening the software security gap
qualifying_updates.factual_summary: A Veracode executive opinion argues that code may compile and pass functional tests while retaining security vulnerabilities, and recommends context-aware verification and enforceable security policy throughout delivery.

local_practice_implications.why_it_matters: Treat this as a practice signal, not independent benchmark proof: structural and context-aware review remains necessary even when generated code appears correct.
Security-focused evidence must complement functional success before acceptance; the raw record labels the source as opinion.
